extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) 6-digit numbers up to lac — Indian system groups: ones period (H, T, O), thousands period (TTh, Th), lakhs period (L). Place value chart left to right: Lakhs, Ten Thousands, Thousands, Hundreds, Tens, Ones. 1,00,000 = one lakh (smallest 6-digit number). Commas placed after lakhs and after thousands period: 2,45,318 NOT 245,318. Read as 'two lakh forty-five thousand three hundred eighteen'. (2) Place value and face value — place value = digit x value of its position (e.g., in 5,73,294 the 7 is in ten thousands place so place value = 70,000). Face value = the digit itself (face value of 7 is always 7). (3) Ascending and descending order — ascending = smallest to largest, descending = largest to smallest. Compare by checking digits from left (lakhs place first). (4) Greatest and smallest from given digits — greatest: arrange digits in descending order (9,75,310 from digits 3,7,1,0,5,9). smallest: arrange in ascending order but do not put 0 at the start (1,03,579). (5) Roman Numerals I, V, X — I=1, V=5, X=10. Addition rule: larger or equal symbol after = add (VI=6, XV=15, XX=20). Subtraction rule: smaller symbol before larger = subtract (IV=4, IX=9). Repetition: I up to 3 times (III=3), X up to 3 times (XXX=30), V never repeated. Convert: 14=XIV, 19=XIX, 29=XXIX, 38=XXXVIII. Misconceptions: 'commas go every three digits like international system' (Indian system uses 2-2-3 grouping: 2,45,318 not 245,318), 'place value and face value are the same' (place value changes with position, face value is always the digit itself), '4 is written as IIII in Roman' (4 is IV — subtraction rule, I before V means 5-1=4), 'V can be repeated' (V is never repeated — VV would be X). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function NumbersGame), NOT export default. Export interface NumbersGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
